unit_note: EVERY frame figure in this file is f@60 — frames of the fixed 1/60 s simulation step. Seam S22: a Souls community frame count is t@30 and is HALF of ours. No number here may be compared to a t@30 figure without the factor of 2.
provenance: constructed — RI-MAG01 is explicit that no frame count, cost, speed or threshold in it is measured in or recalled from Dark Souls, Elden Ring or Morrowind.

commitment.hard_recovery_note: RI-MAG01 §C. Harsher than RI-CMB02 §D's 0.45 for weapons, deliberately: a caster is already spending the fight at range with the spacing advantage, and the recovery tail is what the range costs. hard_until = startup + active + ceil(0.60 × recovery); after that DODGE-cancellable and nothing else.
commitment.aim_latch_note: Tc = ceil(0.65 × startup). RI-AI02's tracking-cutoff law applied to the PLAYER. After Tc the spell goes where it was aimed, not where the target now is.
commitment._acquire_cone_note: The half-angle inside which a LIGHT or HEAVY bolt may acquire the body it then tracks, before the tracking cutoff. It exists so that the arc RI-MAG01 §E declares (60 deg/s LIGHT, 45 HEAVY) is a real number rather than a table nobody can check: wave 1 never set a target on a projectile and the trace measured 0.000 deg/s, which the W1-14 verdict recorded as a declared-vs-observed mismatch under M8. It is deliberately narrow, and acquisition happens ONCE at spawn against the aim the latch already fixed, so RI-MAG01 M4 (median residual aim error >= 25 deg, measured at the RELEASE frame) is untouched and AP-M3 (still turning past the cutoff) stays impossible.

classes.silhouette: one hand snapped forward from the hip, elbow locked, body square — the only cast class that keeps walking
catalyst drawn across the chest and released outward, shoulders opening — a shove
both arms low and wide, weight sunk onto the back foot, catalyst held at the hip and the head down — a gather, feet planted
catalyst raised vertically overhead in both hands with the spine arched back, then driven down — the single tallest silhouette in the player's kit, readable at any range
classes.reference_note: Behavioural reference (A5 rule 2, behaviour only, never art direction): souls-behaviour/anim/telegraph/er-ER_Leyndell_Knight_w_The_Flame_of_Frenzy.gif — 34 GIF frames at 100 ms. The weapon goes vertically overhead and is HELD there for roughly the first 41% of the clip before the slam. Our GREAT startup is 52 of 120 f@60 = 43%. The silhouette change, not the glow, is the tell.

classes.silhouette: kneeling, both palms flat on the ground — the only cast in the game that puts the caster below standing height
classes.ruling_note: RI-MAG01 §B: `RITUAL` is uncastable inside the fight BY CONSTRUCTION, not by a rule. 150 f@60 of startup with zero hyperarmour and zero movement cannot survive contact. There is no `can_cast_in_combat: false` flag anywhere in this build — grep for one and you will not find it. The clock does it.

catalysts.note: The efficiency build; costs you a shield.
Bare-handed Root-Speech. Always possible; always worst. Two-handed by construction, so it keeps the hyperarmour.

hyperarmour_rule: RI-MAG01 §B: HA = [ceil(0.60 × startup), startup + active], DERIVED by RI-CMB02's own formula, and applies ONLY when two-handing a catalyst. One-handed casting with a shield or an off-hand weapon has no hyperarmour at any class.
iframe_rule: Casting grants NO i-frames at any class, at any time, under any catalyst, ever. A cast with i-frames is a dodge with damage attached (RI-MAG01 §D, automatic fail).

startup.effect: none — the spell did not happen

ritual_abort.focus: REFUNDED — the only refund in this item

levitation.no_fence_declaration: There is no altitude clamp, no `no_levitation_zone`, no ceiling plane and no prohibition flag anywhere in game/src or game/data. RI-MAG02 M4.2 greps for one and asserts ZERO hits. The bounds are (F1) drift slower than walking, (F2) 1.5 Focus per metre out of a reservoir that never refills, (F3) AIRBORNE is defenceless, (F4) real ceilings and a real canopy with real gaps.
